end.summary:
Practised showing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified the bundle and loose sticks in the materials.
They counted the bundle as 1 when finding the total, such as 1 bundle and 4 loose ones making 5.
The mix-up remained at the end; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers with one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks. Pointing to the bundle and loose sticks was a useful method, but they continued to count the bundle as only 1 in the total, so the mix-up was not corrected during this lesson. At home, use a group of ten straws and a few single straws, and ask, “How many in the bundle, and how many more?”
